purpose: Durable public-safe dependency registry. ACTIVE human/world gates are owned only by CURRENT.current_heads[].next_executable; this file preserves PARKED dependencies and REMOVED history without manufacturing user obligations.
laws: ACTIVE is derived only from an explicit CURRENT next_executable human/world gate.
A registry item that is not referenced by CURRENT cannot become ACTIVE merely because it exists here.
PARKED preserves a legitimate dependency that is not needed now.
REMOVED preserves provenance for something that no longer qualifies as an actionable waiting gate.
Local acknowledgement does not resolve or close a CURRENT gate.
Sensitive/private content is never stored here; keep only a public-safe dependency description.

capture_protocol.law: MENTION != OBLIGATION; EXPLICIT CURRENT HUMAN GATE == ACTIVE.

routes.condition: CURRENT explicitly selects a next_executable requiring human observation, choice, permission, private input, physical action, ordinary use, or real-device evidence.
routes.destination: ACTIVE at runtime; CURRENT remains authority.

A former dependency is conditional, ambient, superseded, or no longer qualifies as present work.
routes.destination: REMOVED history; preserve provenance, do not surface as YOU.

routes.condition: The next bounded move is executable now with current authority/evidence.
routes.destination: EXECUTE -> RETURN; use CURRENT/QUEUE only when selected live work.

capture_protocol.closure: When CURRENT no longer references an ACTIVE gate, it disappears from ACTIVE automatically. Persist it as PARKED only if the dependency remains legitimately reusable; otherwise preserve it as REMOVED history.
